known_limitations: The per-node complexity figure 116.01 is a single live measurement from 2026-09-01. A server-side re-pricing by Linear would invalidate it and no offline test can detect that; only the live AC1 call can, and it is run manually, not in CI.
AC3 cannot catch M1, and AC6/AC8 cannot catch M4 (see the mutation notes). In each case exactly one assertion owns the property and it is named rather than implied.

LINEAR_CANDIDATE_MAX_NODES = 10000 is a POLICY ceiling that preserves pre-existing capacity. Nothing here establishes it as the largest board Linear would serve; it establishes that a larger board refuses instead of truncating silently.
The capacity regressions use a synthetic in-process transport. They prove the walk's arithmetic and refusal behaviour, not Linear's real cursor semantics at ten-thousand-node scale.
This lane fixes discovery transport and capacity only. Ranking and admission policy are untouched and remain UTV2-1769.
